Prediction markets have a liquidity problem.

Order books die without market makers.
AMMs make LPs bleed out.
Parimutuels punish early believers — late money dilutes their edge.

The Parimutuel Market Maker (PMM) fixes all three.

Let's break down the paper 🧵

First, the problem most engines ignore:

Prediction markets are NOT exchanges. Outcomes resolve, odds shift, and risk is binary — yet they're built on engines designed for spot trading.

The result: either nobody provides liquidity, or the people who do get eaten alive.

1/ Parimutuel: the pool prices itself

Every market is a parimutuel pool. Players back outcomes, and the POOL sets the odds and pays out.

No external market maker needed — liquid from the very first dollar.

2/ Dynamic curves: odds never go stale

Each trade reprices the whole board.

Buy "Yes" and every other outcome reprices instantly — the market always reflects what the crowd actually believes, in real time.

3/ The minimum-return floor: downside floored, upside uncapped

Your minimum payout locks in when you enter — and it can ONLY climb.

Early money gets protected. Late money can't dilute what you already locked.

4/ Counterparty-liquidity rewards: your position pays you to hold

Every position doubles as a yield-bearing stake.

Hold longer → earn more rewards → bigger payout. Volatility literally pays you.

This is the piece that makes passive liquidity viable.

5/ Creator markets: a market for every niche

Anyone can launch a market on anything and earn a cut of EVERY trade it generates — forever.

Market creation becomes recurring revenue, not a one-time event.

6/ DeFi liquidity: $100B+ finally gets in

There's $100B+ sitting in DeFi pools with no way into prediction markets.

The PMM is the first engine that lets that capital in — park capital, earn yield, back outcomes.

The bottom line:

- Parimutuel base → self-pricing pools
- Dynamic curves → never-stale odds
- Min-return floor → protected early money
- Hold-to-earn rewards → passive liquidity works
- Creator markets → anyone can launch & earn

One engine. All of it.
